summary: Current pull-request ownership validation is broken independently of PR scope: the workflow materializes trusted swarmctl_hardening.py without its imported swarmctl_hardening_base.py dependency, so pr-ownership exits with ModuleNotFoundError before validating the PR.
evidence: PR #275 Swarm Control Plane run 31464800316 failed in pr-ownership job 93695374278.
The trusted-validator materialization step copies swarmctl.py and swarmctl_hardening.py into RUNNER_TEMP/trusted-swarm but does not copy swarmctl_hardening_base.py.
The enforcement step raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'swarmctl_hardening_base' before PR ownership validation executes.
